name: chipvoice
description: Five classic sound chips in an AudioWorklet or offline: NES, Game Boy, Mega Drive, SNES and C64. Musical scores and sound effects that borrow hardware voices.
author: Gwendall Esnault (https://gwendall.com)

scripts.build: npm run bank && npm run worklet && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run bank && npm run worklet && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run bank && npm run worklet && (npm run worklet -- --watch & tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch)
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:fresh
